blocks.title: Biodegradable plastic
blocks.text: Biodegradable plastic woh hai jo kuch arse zameen mein dabne par khurdbeeni jaandaron se qudrati taur par saada, ghair zehreele compounds mein toot jaye.

Qudrati polymers, jaise nishasta (starch), wale plastics tezi se toot'te hain, kyunke mitti ke bacteria qudrati polymers par aasani se hamla karte hain. Polyesters aur polyamides poly(alkene)s se zyada biodegradable hain, kyunke mitti ke jaandaar, aur tezaab aur alkalis bhi, in ke ester aur amide links ko saada hisson mein hydrolyse kar sakte hain: polyamides se carboxylic acids aur amines, aur polyesters se carboxylic acids aur alcohols bante hain. Maslan poly(lactic acid) (PLA) plastic ki biodegradability barha sakta hai. Kuch tibbi implants aur ghul jane wale tanke aise polyesters se bante hain jo jism mein hydrolysis se dheere dheere toot'te hain.

blocks.prompt: Polyester poly(ethene) se zyada biodegradable kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ke ester links (tezaab, alkali ya mitti ke jaandaron se) carboxylic acids aur alcohols mein hydrolyse ho sakte hain, jab ke poly(ethene) mein sirf be-asar C-C aur C-H bonds hain.

items: Polyesters aur polyamides ester aur amide links par hydrolyse (PLA, ghulne wale tanke).
